name: apple-contacts
description: Access Apple Contacts on macOS via the Contacts framework — search, read, create, update, and delete contacts and groups, with photos, vCard import/export, and duplicate detection and merging.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Apple Contacts on your Mac via Apple's first-class Contacts framework. Full read+write coverage of the contact data model.

**Features:**
- Browse every account (iCloud, Google, Exchange, On My Mac) and every group
- Search contacts by name, organisation, email, URL, or phone digits — case- and accent-insensitive
- Full contact detail: all name parts, organisation, labeled emails / phones / postal addresses / URLs / social profiles / IM handles / relations / dates, birthday, photo, groups, container
- Create and update contacts with the same full property set; friendly labels ("home", "work", "mobile", "iPhone", custom text) in both directions
- Manage groups: create, rename, delete, add and remove members
- Read and set contact photos
- Import and export vCards
- Find likely duplicates by name, email, or phone, and merge them into one survivor
- Read your own "me" card
- Deep-link any contact via addressbook:// URL

**Requirements:**
- macOS 14 Sonoma or later
- Contacts permission (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Contacts)
- Automation permission for Contacts.app, for notes only (everything else works without it)

**Note on notes:** Apple withholds the note field from processes that lack a special entitlement, so this connector reads and writes notes by scripting Contacts.app instead. That is slower, needs a separate permission, and is only done when a tool is asked for notes explicitly.

tools.name: list_containers
tools.description: List every contacts account (container) with id, name, type, and default flag

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List contact groups with container and member count, optionally within one container

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a contact group in a container

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Rename a contact group

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Delete a contact group (its contacts are kept)

tools.name: add_contacts_to_group
tools.description: Add contacts to a group (idempotent)

tools.name: remove_contacts_from_group
tools.description: Remove contacts from a group

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Aggregate counts: containers, groups, contacts, people vs organisations, with email/phone/photo, birthdays in the next 30 days

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts with filters: container, group, kind, text, has email/phone/image; sortable and paginated

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Free-text search across names, organisation, emails, URLs, and phone digits

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Full detail for a contact — every labeled field, birthday, groups, container, and optionally notes

tools.name: get_contact_link
tools.description: Get an addressbook:// URL that opens the contact in Contacts.app

tools.name: get_me_card
tools.description: The user's own contact card

tools.name: get_contact_image
tools.description: Contact photo (full or thumbnail) as base64 with MIME type

tools.name: export_vcards
tools.description: Export one or more contacts as vCard text, optionally with photos

tools.name: find_duplicate_contacts
tools.description: Clusters of likely duplicates by same name, shared email, or shared phone

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact with the full property set: names, organisation, labeled emails/phones/addresses/URLs/profiles/relations/dates, birthday, notes, container, groups

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update any subset of a contact's properties; lists replace, clear_* flags remove

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a contact (destructive)

tools.name: set_contact_image
tools.description: Set a contact's photo from base64 or a file path, or clear it

tools.name: set_contact_notes
tools.description: Set or clear a contact's note via Contacts.app scripting

tools.name: import_vcards
tools.description: Create contacts from vCard text

tools.name: merge_contacts
tools.description: Merge duplicate contacts into one survivor, unioning fields and groups, then delete the others (destructive)
